subject: Make initial URL available to shiny-server

messages.author: c8fe4075ec631c03
messages.subject: Make initial URL available to shiny-server
parts:
Hi,

  It would be useful if the whole URL used to invoke shiny were available in the shiny-server function - at least on the first invocation.

  Currently this doesn't seem to be exposed - is there some way to get it?

  Why?
  
    While my URL code works well for input values from the page, It has to cycle through a page load before the values are presented to the server, which slows application startup.  Also I'd like to provide some convenience functions where different URL values are mapped to sets of default inputs, for different users, of for using foreign IDs that I can translate to inputs but aren't legal input values in the page.

-Alex
